column1: # figure: manuscript_ph.md / supplement.md 'Lists from other brain diseases' (Extended Methods 4), re-scored at 10 or more lists and against the 383
# script: null_overlap_sets.py and summarize.py of the analysis repository (run 2026-10-22), adapted from the script of the stored 5-or-more run

# draws: rule A (top-L genes by P, L = the 72 schizophrenia list sizes permuted over 72 contrasts drawn without replacement), pool P1_disease (141 contrasts, 11 disease groups, schizophrenia excluded), 2,000 draws, seed 20261012 in 12 chunks: the same random stream as the stored 5-or-more run (check: K>=5 vs 2,422 reproduces its share and expectation, see validation row)
# input: prepared draw inputs; sz_gene_counts_72.tsv sha256 dacfba3dd446 (n_lists >= 5: 2,422; >= 10: 107; in_recurrent_set: 383); draws_long.tsv sha256 6f21ee4b8c91

# share = draw genes in the stated number of lists that are also in the SZ comparison set / draw genes in the stated number of lists (all, including genes outside the common universe, as the stored 5-or-more run). Expected = DE-prior stratified (20 equal-count strata of prior_n over the common genes), same as the stored 5-or-more run expected_share.

# draws with no gene at the stated number of lists have no share; they are excluded from the medians and 2.5-97.5% ranges and counted in draws_with_no_gene_excluded. ratio = share / expected per draw. pooled_* = total overlap / total draw genes over draws (zero-gene draws contribute nothing).
